### workspace session-event --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace session-event [options]

Forward one coding-agent hook event, read as JSON on stdin, to that
workspace's agent daemon. Installed as a hook by 'workspace init';
not normally run by hand.

Exits 2 when the caller's edit lock check fails (a PreToolUse for an
editing tool while another agent holds the edit lock); a missing daemon
otherwise never fails an agent's turn.

Options:
        --workspace NAME             Send to NAME instead of the pane's session
        --agent KIND                 Read the payload as KIND's hook events: claude (the default) or codex

These show what hooks send. Running one records it as a real event: a
session start writes a ledger row, and in a tmux pane the event reaches
the daemon.

Examples:
  workspace session-event <<< '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","session_id":"abc"}'    # as a Claude Code hook calls it, from the agent's pane
  workspace session-event --workspace my-project <<< '{"hook_event_name":"Stop"}'    # from a tmux pane, send to my-project instead of the pane's own session
  workspace session-event <<< '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Edit","cwd":"/src/api"}'    # in a repo where another agent holds the edit lock: exits 2, deny message on stderr
  workspace session-event --agent=codex <<< '{"hook_event_name":"PermissionRequest","tool_name":"Bash"}'    # a Codex approval prompt, as Codex's hook sends it
--- stderr
--- end
